name: Catfish in Disguise
source:
In a world where society is slowly accepting monsters into their community, Em Cee, a monster hunter, is tasked to examine three monsters in the Philippines. Along the way, you must decide whether they’d be a friend or foe to society through the strategy of playing out a date. 

If they pose no danger, then you can spare them. If they pose a danger, then you may slaughter them before they can cause anyone harm. 

But beware, you must guess correctly what kind of monster you plan to kill unless you wish the knife to be turned on you instead.

[From [url=https://delve-murder-nevermore.itch.io/catfish-in-disguise]itch.io[/url]]
